programme.title: PL Greatest:Liverpool/Blackburn'95
programme.desc: Enjoy the greatest Premier League game for each of the league's 47 clubs, as voted for by fans. For Blackburn Rovers, the 2-1 loss to Liverpool that saw Rovers clinch the title.

programme.title: PL Greatest: L'Pool/Blackpool 2010
programme.desc: Blackpool: Enjoy the greatest Premier League game for each of the league's 47 clubs, as voted for by fans. Here, for Blackpool, the 2-1 win at Anfield against Liverpool in October 2010.

programme.title: PL Greatest: Bolton/Chelsea 2005
programme.desc: Chelsea: Enjoy the greatest Premier League game for the league's 49 clubs, as voted for by fans. For Chelsea, the win over Bolton in 2005 that won the Blues their first title in 50 years.

programme.title: Best Premier League Goals 20/21
programme.desc: A selection of incredible strikes during the 2020-2021 Premier League season, including stunners from Mohamed Salah, Mason Mount, Kevin De Bruyne and many more.

programme.title: PL 100 Club: Thierry Henry
programme.desc: A celebration of some of the finest goalscorers in Premier League history. This episode features the best of Thierry Henry's 175 top-flight goals.

programme.title: PL 100 Club: Jamie Vardy
programme.desc: A look back at the goals of the players who have found the net over 100 times in the Premier League. This episode focuses on Leicester City star Jamie Vardy.

programme.title: PL Greatest Games:M City/L'Pool 15
programme.desc: Relive a Premier League classic, as Man City face Liverpool back in November 2015. City needed a win to go back top of the table, while Liverpool were adapting to life under Jurgen Klopp.

programme.title: PL Greatest Games:M City/L'Pool 13
programme.desc: Relive a Premier League classic, as Man City face Liverpool back in 2013. City needed three points to close the gap at the top to Man Utd, while the Reds were chasing a top four spot.

programme.title: PL Greatest Games:Man U/L'Pool '95
programme.desc: A look back at some classic matches in the Premier League. Here, Man United host Liverpool in October 1995, as Eric Cantona returned from his lengthy suspension in a thrilling 2-2 draw.

programme.title: PL Greatest Games:L'Pool/Man U '97
programme.desc: A look back at some classic matches in the Premier League. Here, Liverpool meet Manchester United at Anfield in 1997, in a match that had a happy outcome for the Red Devils.

programme.title: Best PL Goals: Arsenal
programme.desc: Enjoy the best Premier League goals scored by Arsenal over the years, including strikes by club legends Thierry Henry, Dennis Bergkamp and more.

programme.title: PL 100 Club: Thierry Henry
programme.desc: A celebration of some of the finest goalscorers in Premier League history. This episode features the best of Thierry Henry's 175 top-flight goals.

programme.title: PL Icons: Dennis Bergkamp
programme.desc: A look at one of the most iconic players to have graced the Premier League. Here, the focus is on the highly skilled Arsenal legend Dennis Bergkamp.

programme.title: Premier League Years 1997/98
programme.desc: Take a look back at all the memorable moments from the 1997-98 season, a season in which Alex Ferguson's Manchester United and Arsene Wenger's Arsenal had a titanic tussle for the title.

programme.title: Premier League Years 2001/02
programme.desc: Take a look at all the most memorable moments from the 2001-02 Premier League season. It was a memorable one for a certain North London side.

programme.title: PL Years 03/04: Invincibles
programme.desc: A chance to relive a classic season in the Premier League, as Arsene Wenger's Arsenal steamrollered all opposition on their way to the title as they completed a remarkable unbeaten season.

programme.title: Premier League Years 2025-2026
programme.desc: Revisit the annals of Premier League history with the 2025-2026 season, a campaign that saw Mikel Arteta's Arsenal end a 22-year wait for top-flight glory.

programme.title: PL 360: Big Sam's Bolton
programme.desc: This is the story of Sam Allardyce's Bolton. Building a team of global superstars, Big Sam used pioneering sports science and data analysis to take the club on an unforgettable journey.

programme.title: Premier League Goals of The Season
programme.desc: A look at some of the finest strikes throughout the 2025-26 Premier League campaign.

programme.title: How Brazil Changed The Premier League
programme.desc: Brazilians were seldom seen in the Premier League's early days but things have changed. From Juninho and Gilberto Silva to Casemiro and Gabriel, this is the story of the journey.

programme.title: Transfer 360: Patrick Vieira
programme.desc: Get the inside story on how an unknown French midfielder became one of Arsenal's greatest stars. Hear from Patrick Vieira himself and Arsene Wenger on how the deal happened.

programme.title: Transfer 360: Sol Campbell
programme.desc: Find out the inside story of Sol Campbell's move from Spurs to Arsenal, as David Dein, Lord Sugar and Campbell detail how one of the Premier League's most controversial transfers unfolded.

programme.title: Drink It In: The Rise of Man City
programme.desc: Manchester City's rise has been nothing short of meteoric; from an 8-1 humbling in 2008, to six-time Premier League winners. Follow the record breaking journey of the noisy neighbours.

programme.title: Premier League Years 1995/96

programme.title: Shake, Rattle & Roll II
programme.desc: In \"Multo\", a young groom in Baguio for his honeymoon is possessed by a homicidal spirit when he discovers a cursed ring and decides to wear it. \"Kulam\" is set in the eerie halls of a mysterious hospital where a doctor practice voodoo and dead bodies go wandering in the night. \"Aswang\" is about a student who is a guest at a town fiesta in a remote province. The people's hospitable ways leave her clueless about a ritual that takes place at night.
